notes.title: How to Win: Season One is now FREE TO PLAY!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i0.wp.com/hiddentrack.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/ParadiseMountain5.jpg?ssl=1[/img]

In March 2020, Hidden Track were an interactive theatre company, creating work for live audiences that allowed them to break the rules of theatre.

Then COVID hit. And all of the theatres closed. So we decided to see how we could break the rules of video gaming.

In the summer of 2020, we asked our players what the rules of our game should be, how we should break them, and if they could imagine a game that everyone could win.

We were given hundreds of suggestions and ideas, and we put the best ones to a public vote.

Whatever they decided, WHATEVER it was, that was the world we made next.

In 2021, we collected all of those ideas, give our story some reworking and polish, and put it out to you again. We've absolutely loved all of the ideas you've sent it, and the comments we've got from everyone.

Now our story is over. Hidden Track are returning to the world of theatre, to meet people in the flesh again.

Now that our project is over, we have decided to make it available to everyone... COMPLETELY FOR FREE.

No catch, no sneaky microtransactions. We just want to share our story to everyone.

Thanks so much to everyone who's supported us along the way. Now please, go tell your friends!
Show them the world we made together!

[img]https://i0.wp.com/hiddentrack.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/Cha_TinaA_HAPPY.png?w=320&ssl=1[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 is now live! (Ooh, our first patch notes! Fun!)
notes.notes:
